about: Ask Ping evals: questions against the anonymised demo data (what the one-click demo shows), each with deterministic checks. Expected values were written by reading dashboard/demo-data.json, not by running the model.

check_rules.must_contain: every entry must appear in the answer (case-insensitive); an entry 'a|b|c' passes if any alternative appears
check_rules.numbers_present: each number must appear in the answer, written any common way: 2800000, 28,00,000, 2,800,000, 28 L, 28 LPA, 28 lakh, 0.28 Cr (amounts within 0.5%); small numbers exactly (6.0 = 6)
check_rules.max_words: the answer has at most this many words
